findings.title: Missing test for skill-details shape-assertion rethrow
findings.problem: AC16 requires skills data.test.ts to cover AC10-AC12. AC12 has two halves (non-404 rejection, failed shape assertion); only the non-404 rejection is tested. No case has client.skills.get resolve a malformed payload so assertApiListResponse(skill, isSkillDetailResponse, 'skill details') rejects inside fetchSkillsByIds.
findings.impact: Required acceptance criterion AC16 is only partially met; a regression that swallows the shape-assertion error into 'missing' (silently unregistering a valid skill) would go undetected.
findings.recommendation: Add a fetchSkillsByIds test where client.skills.get resolves a payload without a string id and assert the call rejects with the 'skill details' unexpected-response error (not returned in missing).

findings.title: Ambiguous 'missing' sentinel in fetchSkillsByIds
findings.problem: Per-id results are typed SkillDetail | { missing: string } and split with `'missing' in result`. isSkillDetailResponse only checks for a string id, so a server payload that carries its own `missing` property would be classified as missing.
findings.impact: A valid skill would be treated as missing: if registered, warned and unregistered as stale; if newly selected, RegistrationItemNotFoundError aborts the run. Reachability unconfirmed: the SDK SkillDetail type declares no `missing` key, so this needs the server to add one.
findings.recommendation: Use a discriminated result, e.g. return { kind: 'missing', id } / { kind: 'found', skill } and branch on kind.
